TO AMEND SECTION 1-106 AND ORDINANCE 81-1 OF THE CODE OF ORDINANCES, TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, BY AMENDING SUBSECTIONS 5 AND 6 ESTABLISHING THE PROCEDURE FOR THE PROPOSAL, PUBLICATION AND PASSAGE OF NEW ORDINANCES; TO PROVIDE AN EFFECTIVE DATE; TO REPEAL CONFLICTING ORDINANCES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE TOWN COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA THAT SECTION 1-106 AND ORDINANCE 81-1 OF THE CODE OF ORDINANCES, TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA IS HEREBY AMENDED TO READ AS FOLLOWS: |
3:
"5S. Every proposed ordinance, either setting forth a new ordinance or amending or repealing an existing ordinance, shall be introduced in writing and in the form required for final adoption. No ordinance shall contain more than one subject which shall be clearly expressed in its title."

"6. After any proposed ordinance as set forth in Paragraph 5 hereto has been read at a meeting of the Town Council, the title of each proposed new ordinance or the title of each existing ordinance proposed to be amended or repealed shall be published in the official newspaper of the Town of Clermont not less than 15 days nor more than 45 days before it shall come up for passage. The publication shall

contain the date and time of the meeting when the ordinance shall come up for final passage. SECTION IZ. EFFECTIVE DATE.

This Ordinance shall become effective upon its passage. SECTION III. REPEALING ALL CONFLICTING ORDINANCES.

All ordinance and parts of ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby expressly repealed.
